# Three.js r128

`three.module.js` and `OrbitControls.js` are from the official Three.js r128
release, distributed under the adjacent MIT license. The OrbitControls import
was changed to the local module path; one indentation-only whitespace issue in
`three.module.js` was normalized. Files are served locally; the Studio does not
fetch a third-party script at runtime.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128
